regionOverlap.description: How the regions matching one track combine: mostConservative takes the widest minimum (and the earliest alert time) of every matching region, firstInFile the first matching region that names each setting, as TopSky reads its areas file. With mostConservative a tighter region can never narrow a wider one it sits inside.

regionsOnly.description: TopSky: with any TCT area defined, TCT runs only inside the areas. True needs at least one region.

floorFt.description: TopSky's TCT_Floor: no track below this altitude takes part; at or below the transition altitude it is an altitude on QNH, above it a pressure altitude.

vfrPairs.description: Whether a pair of two VFR flights is probed: TopSky's TCT_Inhibit_VFR, on, so false.

uncontrolledPairs.description: Whether a pair of two uncontrolled flights is probed: TCT_Inhibit_Uncontrolled, on, so false. An uncontrolled flight is a VFR one nobody tracks; an IFR flight, or one with no plan, counts as controlled, tracked or not.

uncorrelatedPairs.description: Whether a pair of two uncorrelated tracks alerts: TopSky's TCT_Inhibit_Uncorrelated, off. An uncorrelated track against a correlated aircraft always pairs.

exclusionZoneTag.description: A zones.geojson tag inside which TCT does not look at an aircraft, as STCA's exclusionZoneTag. Empty is none.

scope.description: Who is a source (TopSky's TCT_Min_State_Source): ownedOrConcerned or allVisible. Author sourceStates instead for finer control, never both.

sourceStates.description: The attention states a source may be in, TopSky's TCT_Min_State_Source as a list. In place of scope.

targetStates.description: The attention states the other aircraft of a pair may be in, TopSky's TCT_Min_State_Target. Absent is every state.

severity.description: Board severity per band for a route or heading conflict. TopSky's look is info and warning.

warningBand.description: Board severity of a conflict starting between imminentS and warningS.

imminent.description: Board severity of a conflict starting within imminentS.

textMultiple.description: alertText when the aircraft is in more than one.

yieldToStca.description: One pair, one alert: drop the TCT for any pair STCA holds, as the TCT simulations ranked them. Only while STCA is enabled and shown.

groundTrackTurn.description: Carry the measured turn rate on in the ground track branch, at most half a circle, instead of a straight line. TopSky predicts straight.

stateVector.description: 5370's State Vector class: each aircraft also flown straight along its present ground track, and a conflict found only there ranks above a route or heading one. Off unless authored; it doubles the prediction work.

severity.description: Board severity per band for a State Vector conflict.

levelRangeFt.description: Probe only levels within this many feet of the present one (TopSky's 5000). Absent probes every listed level; a level beyond the range still reads crossed when a conflicting level lies between.

windowS.description: A conflict starting within this many seconds colours the entry. The Blind Spots study's events fit three minutes; TopSky's setting default is 120. For each pair the window is at least the pair's warningS plus cadenceS times confirmChecks (and at most lookaheadS), so a level shown clear cannot raise a TCT once issued. agedS.description: Seconds after which every bar turns the aged colour; never probed again while the menu stays open.

reversalReactionS.description: A level against the present climb or descent holds the present rate this long before turning back, so the overshoot counts. 0 flies it as an instant level-off.

traffic.description: What an entry is probed against: every airborne aircraft with an altitude, TCT judges it or not (an inhibited or uncorrelated aircraft still counts, a stale one makes the entry unknown), or only TCT's eligible tracks.

kinds.description: Per kind, by wire name: the board-level overrides that give a system full control of every net. Every key is optional and absent leaves the net's own behaviour.

severity.description: The severity the net raised, by name, to the one the board shows.

text.description: The alertText: {text} is the net's own wording, {other} the other aircraft. A plain word replaces the net's.

sound.description: Whether a raise sounds: the net's own call (TCT and a STCA outside soundScope are silent), or always, or never. The sound itself is sounds.perKind or the severity's.

exclude.description: Aircraft this net alone never looks at, on top of safetyNets.exclude: callsigns, squawks and when as there. Never on emergency or rimcas.

when.description: A condition as safetyNets.exclude.when takes; an aircraft it holds for is skipped by this net alone.

inhibitable.description: Whether the controller's inhibitAlerts switches this client net off for an aircraft; for STCA, whether it counts toward the two flags that silence a pair. The TCT simulations say a controller should not be able to suppress TCT; a system that agrees authors false. Never on emergency or rimcas.

mutable.description: Whether muteAlerts silences this kind's sounds. Absent is false for emergency and rimcas, which always sound, and true for every other kind.

squawk.description: The squawk provider chain: the package's priority per provider name, providers it disables, the reserved codes no provider may hand out, the circuit codes, and a first-party HTTP allocator. A provider the package does not name keeps what it declared.

providers.description: Keyed by provider name as the provider declares it (Generic, Server, the HTTP allocator's name, a plugin's). Omission keeps the provider; disabling is explicit.

enabled.description: False removes the provider from the chain, logged with the system that did it.

priority.description: Replaces the provider's declared priority for ranking. Higher wins.

reserved.description: Codes never assigned whoever proposes them, in addition to 0000, 7500, 7600 and 7700.

http.description: A first-party HTTP allocator: one POST per request carrying callsign, origin, destination, flightRule, aircraftType, cruiseLevelFt and circuit; one JSON object back carrying the code.

name.description: Provider name in the chain. Default Http.

priority.description: Declared priority. Default 50: above the server, below a plugin's 100.

codeProperty.description: The response property carrying the code. Default code.

apiKeyEnvironmentVariable.description: Environment variable holding the API key, sent as a bearer token. The key never lives in the package.

condition.description: A condition over one aircraft, in the expression language of systems/expressions and of every applyWhen. The key is not enumerated here: expressions.schema.json lists the catalogue, and .dev package-check names a key the client does not know.

anyOf.description: "$name": an expression of the package's systems/expressions file. An empty string asks nothing.

items.description: The key read from the aircraft.
Text, a number, true or false, "&key" for another key's value or "$name" for an expression (compared as "1" or "0").

anyOf.description: A group: ["AND" | "OR" | "NOT", [conditions]]. NOT over several holds when none does.
The short form of a group over one emptiness test: ["NOT", "isEmpty", key].
[]: the condition that always holds, as an absent one does where absence applies.

items.description: The time zone the times are in: an IANA id such as Europe/London, or UTC.

from.description: The first day a window may start: MMDD for a period every year, YYMMDD for a single one.

to.description: The last day a window may start, in the same form as from. A yearly period may run over the new year.

days.description: The weekdays a window may start on, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday, or 0 to run from start on the first day to end on the last.

end.description: HH:MM, up to 24:00. At or before start, the window ends on the following day.

anyOf.description: A time window, TopSky's activation schedule: ["within", zone, {from, to, days, start, end}]. A window that passes midnight stays until its end on the following day.
